rationale: observerEci builds the observer's ECI position from WGS84 geodetic lat/lon using a spherical Earth (RE·cos/sin), misplacing the observer up to ~22 km in z vs the WGS84 ellipsoidal model (N·cos, N(1−e²)·sin). This corrupts the satEci−obsEci range vector that lookAngle feeds into the SEZ rotation, so a body at the observer's geodetic zenith no longer projects to alt=90°. horizontal.ts is a tempting look-alike — it also transforms observer latitude into trig components — but it only performs ecliptic↔equatorial↔alt-az celestial-frame rotations (verified correct by hand); it never positions the observer on the ellipsoid.
